recognize_zh: 芽細胞旁邊有多個細胞質充滿粗大、深紫黑色嗜鹼性顆粒且顆粒覆蓋細胞核的細胞，插圖箭頭指出不成熟細胞的顆粒；芽細胞合併異常嗜鹼性分化，符合急性嗜鹼性白血病。
features: Blast with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular blue cytoplasm
Several cells packed with coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules obscuring the nucleus
Granules extend over the nuclear outline and to the cell periphery; nuclear detail barely visible
Inset: immature cell with a more open nuclear area and coarse basophilic granules (arrow)
describe_en: Peripheral blood (or marrow) smear shows blasts with fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm admixed with abnormal immature basophils whose cytoplasm is packed with coarse, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus. The inset highlights an immature basophilic precursor with coarse granules. In the absence of a BCR::ABL1 fusion or other defining genetic abnormality, and with confirmation by toluidine blue metachromasia and immunophenotype (CD123+, CD203c+, CD117-, tryptase negative or weak), findings are consistent with acute basophilic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: Also shows basophilia with blasts but carries BCR::ABL1 and usually a preceding chronic phase with left-shifted granulocytes.
Mast cells have round/oval nuclei with less nuclear overlap by granules, and are CD117-bright, tryptase-positive and often KIT D816V, unlike CD117-negative basophil blasts.
APL granules are azurophilic red-purple with Auer rod bundles and strong MPO, not coarse metachromatic basophilic granules.

ddx.dx: AML with t(6;9) DEK::NUP214 or inv(3)
ddx.vs: May show accompanying basophilia, but defining cytogenetics establish these as genetically defined entities.
